capabilities: Jump to related notes from keyboard pickers
Define custom navigation lists with property filters
Set several properties of the focused note at once
Create a note from a form of answered questions
Process tasks in the active note or chosen notes
disambiguation: Not only a navigation tool; it also sets properties, fills forms and processes tasks.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; works on desktop and mobile. Interface and readmes are available in English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Detailed instructions live in separate linked manual pages.
problem: Moving between related notes, editing several properties, creating structured notes and handling tasks each need separate commands and manual steps in Obsidian.
summary: Keyboard picker suite for jumping to related notes, setting a note's properties, filling forms to create notes, and processing tasks.
